message.content: {"caption":"Training-step average reward curves for All Returns and Answer-Only strategies, with shaded bands showing variation around each series.","description":"A two-series line chart plots Average Reward (vertical axis, 0 to 1.0) against Training Step (horizontal axis, 0 to 100). The legend identifies the blue dash-dot line as All Returns and the magenta dashed line as Answer-Only. Both curves fluctuate strongly during early training. All Returns then rises to about 0.9–1.0 by roughly step 50 and remains near that level, while Answer-Only generally stays lower, around 0.6–0.8 later in training. The blue series is generally above the magenta series after the early steps. Translucent shaded bands surround both lines and are especially broad during early training.
